claims.assertion: Athena claims Urmah from Avyon-uno destroyed a Pfizer vaccine warehouse with a controlled-gravity tractor beam, believing it held phase-two pandemic vaccines.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: This is Athena’s account of the Urmah’s stated rationale.

claims.assertion: Athena says the Federation condemned the Urmah for violating the Prime Directive through direct intervention.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena says Urmah follow their own agendas and represent Avyon Council, a feline confederation rivaling the Galactic Federation.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena describes Avyon-uno as the Urmah fleet’s flagship, slightly larger than a Toleka, with its own intelligence network.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
